He sealed his answer in the same bottle and threw it far, trusting the current to carry one stranger's wonder toward another.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市还沉在深蓝的梦里。街灯把空旷的马路照成一条安静的河，偶尔有出租车低声驶过。早点铺的卷帘门缓缓升起，白气从蒸笼里冒出来。清洁工的扫帚划过地面，沙沙作响。高楼的窗子大多黑着，只有零星几盏亮灯，像没睡着的眼睛。风是凉的，带着夜雨的余味。再过一个小时，天就会泛白，人潮将重新涌来，可此刻的城市只属于那些醒着的、孤独而温柔的灵魂。", "w03": "• Recursion is when something solves a problem by using a smaller copy of the same problem.\n• Think of standing in a line of mirrors: each reflection shows a slightly smaller version of itself, over and over.\n• It has to stop somewhere, called the base case, like the last tiny mirror that just says the answer."}
